sentences.en: There is no dearth of good will, only of courage.
sentences.zh: 善意不缺乏，缺乏的是勇气。

sentences.en: For a writer there is no dearth of detractors.
sentences.zh: 对于作家来说，批评者并不罕见。

sentences.en: There is a dearth of available medical personnel to administer vaccines.
sentences.zh: 可供接种疫苗的医疗人员严重短缺。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：dear（珍贵的）+th→物以稀为贵→缺乏，短缺
